rationale: The stock gapped down ~10% on extreme relative volume (9.78x) and is sitting at 23% of today's range with no clear directional resolution — price has been drifting lower in the last few candles (12.33 → 12.22) but is also well off the session low of 11.94, suggesting indecision rather than a clean trend. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.05%, VIXY +3.07%), adding macro headwind to any long thesis, while the lack of a defined support/resistance level near current price makes stop placement imprecise and risk/reward unattractive in either direction.
